scope: Targeted static review of work item/project/workspace/user-bot/token/state/parent/relation/cycle/module/page/notification models and source instruction/build metadata; browser and external API task creation/update/delete serializers, default assignment and external ID pre-check, association soft replacement, sequence allocation lock and in-memory change tracker; sub-item reparenting and relation mutation, completion save versus automatic close/bulk-date effects; role/session/API authentication and scoped notification actions; selected asynchronous activity/version/notification/webhook delivery and pinned HTTP helper paths; representative detail/board/store/service/workflow stub, deployment/database/broker/entrypoint source; selected contract assertion bodies read. Relevant task/domain/operation inventories searched for worker claims, leases, attempts, capacity and heartbeat mechanisms. MCP adapter assessed separately. No candidate commands/install/build/migration/tests executed. Not every-line, all integrations/importers/exports/extensions/edition/file/token-management/live collaboration/migration/security/deployment/performance/browser/accessibility or production concurrency certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Project/workspace-scoped serializer creates issue then assignee/label associations and queues effects; transaction-level advisory lock allocates per-project sequence only. External-source/ID duplicate check precedes insertion and has no matching item uniqueness constraint in inspected model; concurrent duplicate risk inferred, not reproduced.
lifecycle_review.select: Filtered shared project/board/API records and native planning cycles/modules; relation links describe blockers but ordinary state/assignment validation does not enforce dependency readiness or cycles. Parent scope checked but reparent method has no self/ancestor check.
lifecycle_review.claim: Multiple assignees are project users; association replacement soft-deletes existing links then bulk-creates replacements and saves item. Pair uniqueness prevents duplicate same assignee, not exclusive claim. No unowned predicate, capacity reservation or current attempt guard; browser/API have differing invalid-list policy.
lifecycle_review.progress: Rich descriptions/comments/files/pages, activity and snapshots. Ordinary PATCH read/validate/save has no expected-version or locking predicate; change tracker compares in-memory load state, not current DB. Browser optimistic rollback snapshots and parallel activity read have reconciliation limits.
lifecycle_review.review: States and discussion can express review, but no required accepted child results, verification/reviewer identity or immutable result revision gate. Description/issue snapshots coalesce same-owner edits within ten minutes and are not OCC/attempt versions.
lifecycle_review.complete: Model completion timestamp follows newly assigned/changed completed state group. No parent join. Old-item auto close bulk-writes state only, bypassing model timestamp sync; unconfigured fallback chooses first cancelled State without project filter. Static findings, not exercised.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Cancelled state, archive and soft delete manage records; soft related cleanup queued. API admin/creator check. No agent process abort, executable resume, credential-generation revocation or external effect rollback supplied by work item lifecycle.
lifecycle_review.recover: Shared PostgreSQL/API authority and persisted history/notifications permit later inspection, not worker lease recovery. Activity/notifications queued after primary save and general errors caught; mixed browser skip_activity+description edit bypasses route activity/model/version effects. Bulk dates queue effects before final mutation. Webhook transport retries/signatures/logs exist, returned error HTTP status is not raised in inspected chain; per-invocation delivery UUID not stable retry key. Multi-service backup/restore/upgrade/runtime unverified.
